name: lineward
description: Offline static analysis of dbt projects targeting Snowflake, for Codex: the Lineward MCP tools (model context, blast radius, column lineage, project diagnostics) and the workflow skills that use them. Needs the `lineward` binary on PATH, and the tools a key in LINEWARD_LICENSE_KEY.

interface.shortDescription: Offline static analysis of dbt projects on Snowflake
interface.longDescription: The Lineward MCP tools (model context, blast radius, column lineage, project diagnostics) and six skills for editing, renaming and fixing dbt models, answering lineage questions, setting up a CI check and tuning Lineward's settings. Fully offline: no warehouse, no network. Needs the `lineward` binary on PATH; the tools and `lineward check` need a key in LINEWARD_LICENSE_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Which models use the column amount of orders?
What breaks downstream if I rename this column?
Fix the Lineward findings of this dbt project
